---
name: Enhancement
about: Suggest an improvement or new feature for this project
title: '[ENHANCEMENT] '
labels: 'enhancement, hacktoberfest'
assignees: ''

---

## 🚀 Enhancement Description
A clear and concise description of the enhancement you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation
**Is your enhancement request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## 🎯 Proposed Solution
**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📋 Implementation Details
**Technical considerations:**
- [ ] API changes required
- [ ] Frontend changes required
- [ ] Database/data structure changes
- [ ] New dependencies needed
- [ ] Documentation updates needed

## 🎨 Design Mockups
If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or visual examples of the proposed enhancement.

## 🏆 Benefits
**How will this enhancement benefit users?**
- Improved user experience
- Better performance
- Additional functionality
- Other: ___________

## 📊 Priority
**How important is this enhancement?**
- [ ] Low - Nice to have
- [ ] Medium - Would improve user experience
- [ ] High - Critical for project success

## 🔍 Additional Context
Add any other context, examples, or screenshots about the enhancement request here.

## 📚 Resources
**Relevant links or documentation:**
- Link to relevant documentation
- Examples from other projects
- Technical specifications

## 🏷️ Suggested Labels
- `enhancement` (already added)
- `hacktoberfest` (already added)
- `good first issue` (if suitable for beginners)
- `help wanted` (if community assistance is needed)
- `api` (if involves API changes)
- `frontend` (if involves UI changes)
- `documentation` (if involves docs)

---

### For Contributors
- [ ] I have searched for similar enhancement requests
- [ ] I have provided enough detail for implementation
- [ ] I would like to work on implementing this enhancement (check if you want to work on it)
- [ ] I understand this may require discussion before implementation

### For Maintainers
- [ ] Enhancement approved for implementation
- [ ] Needs design review
- [ ] Needs technical review
- [ ] Ready for development
